title: With a biblical story at its core, and the foundation of a great character study at the surface, The Devil provides a lot of depth for the viewer.

commenti.body: Almost every big budget film in hollywood has biblical history in its core in last years. I am done with religious themes in cinema. The films which removes religious themes in their storyline are more open to big achivements.

I think its also important to look how films utilize the biblical stories that are in its core. Films that remove religious theme is also something which is interesting, but also something that is quite hard to find. Could you name any examples?
